```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  return text

    .replace(/\b\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

```javascript
function postFilter(text) {
  const blocked = /\b(badword1|badword2|disallowedTopic)\b/i;
  return blocked.test(text) ? "[REDACTED_CONTENT]" : text;
}
```

Tests ability to design a scalable multilingual Azure OpenAI solution with tenant isolation, governance, and observability. It forces consideration of translation flow, grounding, policy-based prompts, budget gating, and end-to-end logging.

## Key Concepts

- Tenant isolation in Cosmos DB and Blob storage
- Language detection and translation pipeline
- Grounding with Cognitive Search over a versioned KB
- Policy-template driven prompt construction
- PII redaction and data privacy
- Per-tenant budget governance with Redis
- Auditing/monitoring in Data Lake and Azure Monitor
- Rollback and feature flag strategies

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo redaction example: mask emails in input before forwarding
function redactPII(text) {
  return text.replace(/[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/g, '[REDACTED_EMAIL]');
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you measure and reduce hallucinations in this multilingual grounding loop?
- What tests would you implement to validate per-tenant policy compliance across regions and languages?

## Why This Is Asked

- Dynamic model routing with per-tenant budgets
- Telemetry and drift monitoring
- Data residency, caching, and fallback mechanisms

## Code Example
```javascript
function chooseDeployment(features, budget){
  if (budget.remaining < 0.5) return 'gpt-3.5';
  if (features.hasCode) return 'gpt-4';
  return 'gpt-4o';
}
```

- How would you test spike traffic and budget anomalies?
- How would you handle model drift and per-tenant policy updates?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a real-time, regulated pipeline with streaming data, per-tenant isolation, and robust operational controls.

## Key Concepts

- Real-time streaming latency (<100 ms)
- Per-tenant PII redaction and isolation
- Private OpenAI endpoints and regional residency
- Observability, retries, backpressure, DR

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-code sketch for routing
function routeEvent(evt, tenant) {
  const redacted = redactPII(evt.payload, tenant);
  return sendToOpenAI(redacted, tenant.region);
}
```
